tasks.short: Develop specifications and communicate them to technology staff.

steps.what: Develop technical specifications for the programming.
Set the management needs those specifications cover.
Write how they communicate those needs.
Send the accepted specifications to technology staff.

tasks.design: The data manager develops the technical specifications and the needs they cover, and writes the message. They accept that version. The {EMAIL} sends only that version to the technology staff. Nothing writes the specification.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specification is written, then pasted again into a message.
tasks.enabler_now: A message can carry a specification the person has already accepted.
tasks.still_hard: What the program must do is still the data manager's specification.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager writes the specifications and accepts them before they are sent.
tasks.altitude: Writing the specifications stays with the data manager. The message is only the version they accept.

reach.task: Build from specifications the data manager accepted
reach.learn: The needs were written by the data manager

evidence.claim: The person writes the technical specification. A send can carry only the version they have accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a programming need is known and ends when the accepted specifications are sent. The data manager writes them. The message is that version.
The fields are the need, the specification text, the acceptance, and the recipient. They write the text. If a section is missing, they write it. Nothing drafts the specification.
The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps agree that writing the specification stays with the person. They disagree only about sending a version they have already accepted.
Upkeep is keeping the specification titles aligned with the messages.
unknowns: Whether technology staff expect the specification in a ticket rather than mail.
Which programming needs are in scope.
research_questions: Do technology staff expect the specification in a ticket rather than mail?
Which programming needs are in scope?

already_counted.description: Developing the technical specifications stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the specification titles aligned with the messages

approvals.approved_version: technical specifications the data manager accepted before they were sent

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If technology staff still need a meeting to hear the needs, that meeting stays, and the low end is writing the specifications, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write manuals, capture guidelines, and procedures.

steps.what: Write instruction headings for the manuals.
Draft operating procedures from those headings.

loop.purpose: Draft a procedure section from approved headings.
loop.input: The headings and the approved plan fields.
loop.output: A draft section with no new citation.
loop.check: The data manager compares each sentence with the headings and rejects any citation that was not in the source.
loop.stop: Stop when they accept or reject. The draft never files itself.
loop.why_not_simpler: A procedure is prose. A template of headings cannot write the instruction.

steps.what: Check the procedures against the capture guidelines.

tasks.design: The data manager writes the instruction headings. A draft of the operating procedures is proposed from those headings and from the approved plan fields. They check it against the capture guidelines and reject any citation that was not in the source. They accept the procedures. The file stores that version. The draft never files itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each manual is written from a blank page even when the headings are already agreed.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can be proposed from headings the person has already written. It cannot approve itself.
tasks.still_hard: The data manager still has to check every sentence. A procedure that invents a citation is not fit to file.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager writes the headings, checks the draft, and accepts the procedures.
tasks.altitude: The headings, the check, and the acceptance stay with the data manager. The file holds the procedures only after they accept them.

reach.task: Follow a procedure the data manager accepted
reach.learn: The procedure was checked by the data manager

evidence.claim: EU rules have required AI literacy since February 2025 for people who use a system that drafts text. The person must be able to accept or reject the draft.
EU clinical-trial rules require verifiable records, and the master file is kept for 25 years.
A draft from approved headings still needs the person to check it and to reject any citation that was not in the source.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a procedure is needed and ends when the accepted procedures are on the file. The data manager writes the headings and accepts the text. The draft adds no citation.
The fields are the heading, the source sentence, the draft sentence, and their acceptance. They write the heading. If the draft adds a citation, they reject it. The draft never files itself.
The prior treats the task as automate. The steps agree that a draft can start from headings. They disagree by keeping the headings, the check, and the acceptance.
Upkeep is reviewing drafts the data manager rejects, and keeping the headings aligned with the file.
unknowns: Whether a quality group must also sign the procedure.
Which capture guidelines are the source.
research_questions: Must a quality group also sign the procedure?
Which capture guidelines are the source?

already_counted.description: Checking the procedures against the capture guidelines stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Review drafts the data manager rejects, and keep the headings aligned with the file

approvals.approved_version: operating procedures the data manager accepted after checking them against the headings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If every sentence must be written by hand, the draft stays unused, and the low end is the headings and the check, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Track in-house and electronic forms transfer.

steps.what: Track in-house forms the status missed.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} shows electronic forms transfer status if it already records receipt. That view is configured before any custom tracker. The data manager still tracks in-house forms the status missed, reviews the exceptions, and accepts the note. The file stores that note. A status does not decide that a form is complete.
tasks.previous_blocker: Transfer status is copied from the clinical system into a sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: The clinical system's own receipt status can be shown before a custom tracker is built.
tasks.still_hard: A form the status missed still has to be found by the data manager.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager tracks the forms the status missed and accepts the note.

ambition.what: See a missed transfer the day the status breaks, rather than at a weekly reconciliation.

tasks.altitude: Tracking a missed form and accepting the note stay with the data manager. The status view is the system's own receipt record.

reach.task: Resend a form the data manager found missing
reach.learn: The exception was reviewed by the data manager

evidence.claim: Clinical Data Studio does automated listings review, query management, reconciliation, and audit-trail review.
Form-transfer status can be the clinical system's own receipt record. The person still handles a form that status missed.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a form is expected and ends when the accepted note is on the file. The data manager handles exceptions. The system's own status is tried before a custom tracker.
The fields are the form id, the receipt time, the exception, and their acceptance. The system produces the receipt time. They produce the exception. If the status is blank, they track the form.
The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps agree that exceptions stay with the person. They disagree by reading a status the system already keeps, instead of copying it into a sheet.
Upkeep is keeping the expected-form list aligned with the note.
unknowns: Whether the clinical system already shows receipt of an electronic form.
Which in-house forms never enter that system.
research_questions: Does the clinical system already show receipt of an electronic form?
Which in-house forms never enter that system?

already_counted.description: Tracking in-house forms the status missed stays with the data manager

incremental.description: Keep the expected-form list aligned with the note

approvals.approved_version: forms transfer note the data manager accepted after reviewing the exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the system shows no receipt status, the tracking stays, and the low end is finding the missed forms, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Supervise the project work with those staff.
Supervise staff against the management plan.

tasks.design: The data manager supervises the project staff in person and against the management plan. No score is kept and no dashboard is built. The conversation is not recorded. There is no tool to maintain.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision is the work. A sheet of scores would be a different and unwelcome task.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in this task is a record that a tool should keep.
tasks.still_hard: Supervision stays with the data manager. A score of a worker is not supervision.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager supervises the staff. Nothing is recorded as a score.
tasks.altitude: Supervision stays with the data manager in full. No score of staff is built.

reach.task: Do the work the data manager supervises
reach.learn: The supervision stays with the data manager

evidence.claim: Dutch works-council law requires consent before a dashboard shows an individual worker's performance. This design does not build that dashboard. Other countries set their own rules.
Supervision is watching the work with the staff. No score of a person is kept, and no tool is added.

assumptions: The workflow starts and ends with the supervision. The whole of it stays with the data manager. No dashboard of individual performance is built. Incremental upkeep is zero because no tool is added.
There is no field contract. The data manager sees the work. Nothing extracts it and nothing scores it.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree, and they stay at the full remaining time.
Incremental upkeep is zero because no tool is added and the supervision stays entirely with the data manager.
unknowns: Whether a works council treats any note of this supervision as staff monitoring.
How many project staff the data manager supervises.
research_questions: Does a works council treat any note of this supervision as staff monitoring?
How many project staff does the data manager supervise?

already_counted.description: Supervising the staff stays in full across these steps

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The whole supervision stays. There is no separate case in which a tool does part of it. Incremental upkeep is zero because no tool is added. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The data manager still writes the specification and accepts it before it is sent. They still check every procedure against the headings. They still handle a transfer the status misses. Supervision stays with them in full, with no score of staff.
reach: Technology staff build from specifications the data manager accepted
Project staff follow a procedure the data manager accepted
skills_to_grow: Writing the specification rather than having it drafted
Rejecting a procedure citation that was not in the source
role.ambitious_version: Every specification that is sent, and every procedure that is filed, is one the data manager accepted.
